lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Start a multi-layer Collector import and kill the application process during one layer fill
Before reopening the target project, activate another project and inspect both layers.db files
Reopen the application in the other project and wait beyond the normal repair delay
Return to the original project and wait for repair
Inspect referenced layer directories, marked partial directories, unmarked legacy layer directories and a large referenced MBTiles layer
value.expected: The durable journal waits while another project is active and creates no tables or rows in its layers.db. After returning to the matching project, existing complete layers and referenced directories are retained, only missing or broken layers are queued again, marked unreferenced stages and their tables are removed, and every unmarked legacy directory plus the referenced MBTiles layer remains untouched.
